title: Good Friends Again
synopsis: A story of two childhood friends’ estrangement and reconciliation!

fullText.simplified:
又是好朋友了

    强子和刚子都是老北京，他们的家就在北京的胡同里。他俩已经做了三十多年的老邻居了。
    强子和刚子小时候关系还行，一起上下学，一起调皮捣蛋。到了青春期，他俩就开始有矛盾了。那时强子的学习没有刚子的好，强子的父母天天说刚子好，刚子厉害。因为这个原因，强子开始讨厌刚子了。有时候遇到刚子，强子还会故意说一些难听的话让刚子生气。二十多岁的时候，他俩同时喜欢上了一个姑娘。结果姑娘看上了刚子，强子就更讨厌刚子了，他觉得刚子就是他的克星。只要有刚子在，自己永远是条虫。
    就这样，强子和刚子的关系越来越不好，甚至到了见面都不打招呼的程度。后来，刚子结婚后在四环外买了新房子，他和老婆搬到了新房子住。因为跟老邻居们呆久了，刚子的父母则留在老房子这边。强子呢，因为学历不高，工作一般，买不起房子，就继续跟父母一起住在胡同里。
    本以为再也没有交流的两个人却因为一场意外重新和好了。
    这天，强子下班回家，路过刚子家门口。看到一个人鬼鬼祟祟地进了刚子家。强子记得父母说刚子的父母都出去旅游了，现在根本不可能在家。那么现在去他家的人只有一种可能，那就是小偷。于是，强子偷偷跟了上去。进门的时候，他看到门口有个木棒，就拿在了手里防身用。果不其然，那个人进了屋就开始翻找起来，把值钱的东西都放进了包里。强子先打开手机的录像功能，把小偷偷东西的过程录了下来，紧接着他就大喊一声别动，冲进了屋里。小偷看见有人来了，就立刻从包里掏出了一把刀，恶狠狠地说：“滚开，不然老子捅了你！”强子冷笑一声说：“有本事你就试试。”说完强子就和小偷扭打在了一起。
    中国有句老话说的是：狗急了跳墙，兔子急了咬人。这小偷看到强子不好对付，就不管不顾了。他拿着刀一顿乱捅。虽然强子手里有木棒，但是一个没注意，肚子上还是被捅了一刀，强子疼得捂着肚子蹲在了地上。小偷趁机逃跑了。
    后来，邻居们把受伤的强子送去了医院，因为伤势严重，他在医院一呆就是一个多月。这期间，刚子的父母和刚子本人经常来医院看他，慢慢地强子和刚子的关系缓和了不少。
    在一次聊天的过程中，刚子跟强子说：“我知道你为什么疏远我，但是我从没有看不起你的时候。人各有所长，也各有所短。何必在乎外人的眼光呢？在我心中，你非常厉害，至少在勇气这方面，你比我强百倍。”强子听了刚子的话，什么都没说，只是伸出了他的手，刚子也伸出了他的手，两只手握在了一起。此时无声胜有声，紧握的手告诉所有人他们的误会彻底解开了。
fullText.traditional:
又是好朋友了

    強子和剛子都是老北京，他們的家就在北京的胡同裡。他倆已經做了三十多年的老鄰居了。
    強子和剛子小時候關係還行，一起上下學，一起調皮搗蛋。到了青春期，他倆就開始有矛盾了。那時強子的學習沒有剛子的好，強子的父母天天說剛子好，剛子厲害。因為這個原因，強子開始討厭剛子了。有時候遇到剛子，強子還會故意說一些難聽的話讓剛子生氣。二十多歲的時候，他倆同時喜歡上了一個姑娘。結果姑娘看上了剛子，強子就更討厭剛子了，他覺得剛子就是他的剋星。只要有剛子在，自己永遠是條蟲。
    就這樣，強子和剛子的關係越來越不好，甚至到了見面都不打招呼的程度。後來，剛子結婚後在四環外買了新房子，他和老婆搬到了新房子住。因為跟老鄰居們呆久了，剛子的父母則留在老房子這邊。強子呢，因為學歷不高，工作一般，買不起房子，就繼續跟父母一起住在胡同裡。
    本以為再也沒有交流的兩個人卻因為一場意外重新和好了。
    這天，強子下班回家，路過剛子家門口。看到一個人鬼鬼祟祟地進了剛子家。強子記得父母說剛子的父母都出去旅遊了，現在根本不可能在家。那麼現在去他家的人只有一種可能，那就是小偷。於是，強子偷偷跟了上去。進門的時候，他看到門口有個木棒，就拿在了手裡防身用。果不其然，那個人進了屋就開始翻找起來，把值錢的東西都放進了包裡。強子先打開手機的錄像功能，把小偷偷東西的過程錄了下來，緊接著他就大喊一聲別動，衝進了屋裡。小偷看見有人來了，就立刻從包裡掏出了一把刀，惡狠狠地說：“滾開，不然老子捅了你！”強子冷笑一聲說：“有本事你就試試。”說完強子就和小偷扭打在了一起。
    中國有句老話說的是：狗急了跳牆，兔子急了咬人。這小偷看到強子不好對付，就不管不顧了。他拿著刀一頓亂捅。雖然強子手裡有木棒，但是一個沒注意，肚子上還是被捅了一刀，強子疼得捂著肚子蹲在了地上。小偷趁機逃跑了。
    後來，鄰居們把受傷的強子送去了醫院，因為傷勢嚴重，他在醫院一呆就是一個多月。這期間，剛子的父母和剛子本人經常來醫院看他，慢慢地強子和剛子的關係緩和了不少。
    在一次聊天的過程中，剛子跟強子說：“我知道你為什麼疏遠我，但是我從沒有看不起你的時候。人各有所長，也各有所短。何必在乎外人的眼光呢？在我心中，你非常厲害，至少在勇氣這方面，你比我強百倍。”強子聽了剛子的話，什麼都沒說，只是伸出了他的手，剛子也伸出了他的手，兩隻手握在了一起。此時無聲勝有聲，緊握的手告訴所有人他們的誤會徹底解開了。

sentences.pinyin: suī rán qiáng zǐ shǒu lǐ yǒu mù bàng dàn shì yí ge méi zhù yì dù zi shang hái shi bèi tǒng le yì dāo
sentences.english: The thief saw that Qiangzi was not easy to deal with and recklessly took the knife and stabbed randomly.

sentences.simplified: 强子疼得捂着肚子蹲在了地上。小偷趁机逃跑了。
sentences.traditional: 強子疼得捂著肚子蹲在了地上。小偷趁機逃跑了。
sentences.pinyin: qiáng zǐ téng de wǔ zhe dù zi dūn zài le dì shang xiǎo tōu chèn jī táo pǎo le
sentences.english: Although Qiangzi had a wooden stick in his hand, he wasn’t paying attention and was still stabbed in the stomach.
Qiangzi was in so much pain that he held his hand to his stomach and squatted on the ground. The thief took the opportunity to run away.

sentences.simplified: 后来，邻居们把受伤的强子送去了医院，
sentences.traditional: 後來，鄰居們把受傷的強子送去了醫院，
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái lín jū men bǎ shòu shāng de qiáng zǐ sòng qù le yī yuàn

sentences.simplified: 因为伤势严重，他在医院一呆就是一个多月。
sentences.traditional: 因為傷勢嚴重，他在醫院一呆就是一個多月。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi shāng shì yán zhòng tā zài yī yuàn yì dāi jiù shì yí ge duō yuè
sentences.english: Later, neighbors took the injured Qiangzi to the hospital, ..

sentences.simplified: 这期间，刚子的父母和刚子本人经常来医院看他，
sentences.traditional: 這期間，剛子的父母和剛子本人經常來醫院看他，
sentences.pinyin: zhè qī jiān gāng zǐ de fù mǔ hé gāng zǐ běn rén jīng cháng lái yī yuàn kàn tā
sentences.english: .. where he stayed for more than a month because of the severity of his injuries.

sentences.simplified: 慢慢地强子和刚子的关系缓和了不少。
sentences.traditional: 慢慢地強子和剛子的關係緩和了不少。
sentences.pinyin: màn man de qiáng zǐ hé gāng zǐ de guān xi huǎn hé le bù shǎo
sentences.english: During this period, Gangzi’s parents and Gangzi himself often came to see him in the hospital, ..
.. and slowly, the relationship between Qiangzi and Gangzi eased up a lot.

sentences.simplified: 在一次聊天的过程中，刚子跟强子说：“我知道你为什么疏远我，但是我从没有看不起你的时候。
sentences.traditional: 在一次聊天的過程中，剛子跟強子說：“我知道你為什麼疏遠我，但是我從沒有看不起你的時候。
sentences.pinyin: zài yí cì liáo tiān de guò chéng zhōng gāng zǐ gēn qiáng zǐ shuō wǒ zhī dào nǐ wèi shén me shū yuǎn wǒ dàn shì wǒ cóng méi yǒu kàn bu qǐ nǐ de shí hou

sentences.simplified: 人各有所长，也各有所短。何必在乎外人的眼光呢？
sentences.traditional: 人各有所長，也各有所短。何必在乎外人的眼光呢？
sentences.pinyin: rén gè yǒu suǒ cháng yě gè yǒu suǒ duǎn hé bì zài hu wài rén de yǎn guāng ne
sentences.english: One time when they were chatting, Gangzi said to Qiangzi, “I know why you became estranged from me, but I’ve never looked down on you.

sentences.simplified: 在我心中，你非常厉害，至少在勇气这方面，你比我强百倍。”
sentences.traditional: 在我心中，你非常厲害，至少在勇氣這方面，你比我強百倍。”
sentences.pinyin: zài wǒ xīn zhōng nǐ fēi cháng lì hai zhì shǎo zài yǒng qì zhè fāng miàn nǐ bǐ wǒ qiáng bǎi bèi
sentences.english: Each person has his own strengths and weaknesses. Why care about what other people think?

sentences.simplified: 强子听了刚子的话，什么都没说，只是伸出了他的手，
sentences.traditional: 強子聽了剛子的話，什麼都沒說，只是伸出了他的手，
sentences.pinyin: qiáng zǐ tīng le gāng zǐ de huà shén me dōu méi shuō zhǐ shì shēn chū le tā de shǒu
sentences.english: In my mind, you’re incredible. At least in terms of courage, you are a hundred times stronger than me.”

sentences.simplified: 刚子也伸出了他的手，两只手握在了一起。
sentences.traditional: 剛子也伸出了他的手，兩隻手握在了一起。
sentences.pinyin: gāng zǐ yě shēn chū le tā de shǒu liǎng zhī shǒu wò zài le yì qǐ
sentences.english: When Qiangzi heard what Gangzi said, he didn’t say anything and just stretched out his hand.

sentences.simplified: 此时无声胜有声，紧握的手告诉所有人他们的误会彻底解开了。
sentences.traditional: 此時無聲勝有聲，緊握的手告訴所有人他們的誤會徹底解開了。
sentences.pinyin: cǐ shí wú shēng shèng yǒu shēng jǐn wò de shǒu gào su suǒ yǒu rén tā men de wù huì chè dǐ jiě kāi le
sentences.english: Gangzi stretched out his hand too, and the two hands clasped together.

sentence_translations: Good Friends Again
Qiangzi and Gangzi are both native Beijingers. Their homes are located in the hutongs of Beijing.
They have been neighbors for more than 30 years.
The relationship between Qiangzi and Gangzi was fine when they were kids.
They went to and from school together and caused trouble together.
By the time they reached adolescence, the two of them began to have conflicts.
At that time, Qiangzi didn’t do as well as Gangzi in his studies, ..
.. and every day Qiangzi’s parents said how great and amazing Gangzi was.
Because of this, Qiangzi started to dislike Gangzi.
Sometimes when he ran into Gangzi, Qiangzi would also deliberately say some harsh words to make Gangzi angry.
When they were in their twenties, they both liked the same girl.
In the end, the girl fell for Gangzi, which made Qiangzi hate him even more. He felt that Gangzi was his nemesis.
As long as Gangzi was there, he would always be a worm.
In this way, the relationship between Qiangzi and Gangzi got worse and worse, ..
.. and they wouldn’t even say hello to each other when they met.
Later, after getting married, Gangzi bought a new apartment outside the 4th Ring Road, and he and his wife moved into the new apartment.
Gangzi’s parents chose to stay in the old house as they had been living with their neighbors for a long time.
As for Qiangzi, since his educational level was not high, he had a mediocre job and couldn’t afford to buy an apartment.
So he continued to live with his parents in the hutong.
The two people who thought they would never communicate again became reconciled by accident.
That day, Qiangzi came home from work and passed by the door of Gangzi’s house.
He saw someone sneaking into Gangzi’s house.
Qiangzi remembered his parents saying that Gangzi’s parents had gone on a trip and that they wouldn’t be at home right now.
That only left the possibility that the person entering the house was a thief.  So, Qiangzi stealthily followed him.
When he entered the house, he saw a wooden stick by the door and took it in his hand to defend himself.
As expected, the man entered the house and started rummaging around, putting all the valuable things in a bag.
Qiangzi first turned on the video recording function on his phone and recorded the thief stealing things, ..
.. and then immediately shouted, “Don’t move” while charging into the house.
When the thief saw someone coming, he immediately took out a knife from his bag and said fiercely, “Go away, or I’ll stab you!”
Qiangzi sneered and said, “Try it if you can.” Then Qiangzi and the thief wrestled together.
There is an old Chinese saying: When a dog is desperate, it will jump over a wall. When a hare is desperate, it will bite.
The thief saw that Qiangzi was not easy to deal with and recklessly took the knife and stabbed randomly.
Although Qiangzi had a wooden stick in his hand, he wasn’t paying attention and was still stabbed in the stomach.
Qiangzi was in so much pain that he held his hand to his stomach and squatted on the ground. The thief took the opportunity to run away.
Later, neighbors took the injured Qiangzi to the hospital, ..
.. where he stayed for more than a month because of the severity of his injuries.
During this period, Gangzi’s parents and Gangzi himself often came to see him in the hospital, ..
.. and slowly, the relationship between Qiangzi and Gangzi eased up a lot.
One time when they were chatting, Gangzi said to Qiangzi, “I know why you became estranged from me, but I’ve never looked down on you.
Each person has his own strengths and weaknesses. Why care about what other people think?
In my mind, you’re incredible. At least in terms of courage, you are a hundred times stronger than me.”
When Qiangzi heard what Gangzi said, he didn’t say anything and just stretched out his hand.
Gangzi stretched out his hand too, and the two hands clasped together.
At this moment, silence spoke louder than words. The clasped hands told everyone that their misunderstandings were completely resolved.
